title: Emily Blunt Addresses a Possible Return in Sicario 3
excerpt:
Emily Blunt has discussed her enduring connection to the original Sicario.
Her participation in a third film remains unconfirmed.
body_md:
Emily Blunt has revisited the lasting appeal of Sicario, the 2015 crime thriller directed by Denis Villeneuve. She said the movie built an unusually devoted following over time, even though its initial theatrical performance did not fully reflect that reputation.

Blunt recalled hearing praise for the film from police officers, security personnel and passport-control staff. Her character, FBI agent Kate Macer, did not return for Sicario: Day of the Soldado, which instead followed Alejandro and Matt, played by Benicio del Toro and Josh Brolin.

Although Blunt expressed affection for the material and her collaborators, she did not confirm a contract to reprise Kate Macer. Reports have linked director Patrick McKinley and writer Steven Knight to development discussions, but neither an appearance by Blunt nor a release date should be treated as officially settled.
